desktop: class Solution { public int minMeetingRooms(int[][] intervals) { int n = intervals.length; int[] starts = new int[n], ends = new int[n]; for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) { starts[i] = intervals[i][0]; ends[i] = intervals[i][1]; } Arrays.sort(starts); Arrays.sort(ends); int used = 0, e = 0; for (int s : starts) { if (s >= ends[e]) e++; else used++; } return used; } }

class Solution { public: int minMeetingRooms(vector<vector<int>>& intervals) { vector<int> starts, ends; for (auto& in : intervals) { starts.push_back(in[0]); ends.push_back(in[1]); } sort(starts.begin(), starts.end()); sort(ends.begin(), ends.end()); int used = 0, e = 0; for (int s : starts) { if (s >= ends[e]) e++; else used++; } return used; } };
